mission.goal: Create a governed interactive JARVIS foundation that combines explicit Gemini routing, Federation capability truth, scientific doctrine, deterministic mathematics, exact authority gates, semantic verification and non-self-promoting learning.
mission.user: Kagiso Kim Mosiane as sovereign owner and operator
mission.workflow: intake -> evidence context -> advisory twin -> reason -> semantic verification -> learning capture -> stop; effectful tools require a separate exact action transaction
mission.data: Untrusted objectives and provider outputs are processed in memory; only secret-free hashes, route state, elapsed time and learning status are persisted in the local hash chain.
mission.interface: Responsive browser UI, JSON HTTP API, CLI and Google ADK 2 Workflow entrypoint
mission.stack: Python 3.11-3.14, google-adk 2.1.0, google-genai 2.6.0, stdlib HTTP and Docker
mission.environment: Local/offline is verified; Gemini, Workspace, Cloud Run and Federation adapters require environment-specific authority proof.
mission.governance: One sovereign executor, typed action/resource/argument schemas, full effective-authority intersection, subject/mission-version/resource/argument-bound single-use permits, untrusted external content, semantic readback and no runtime self-promotion.
mission.failure: Invalid input, authorization denial, missing provider configuration, dependency failure, timeout, partial writes, generic responses, ledger tamper and route recurrence fail closed or quarantine only the affected route.
mission.testing: Twenty-two local unit/integration/failure-first tests plus compilation, CLI, deterministic math, denial, contract and doctrine smokes.
mission.deployment: Container source exists; promotion is blocked until installed SDK integration, dependency lock, isolated production signer and global state, machine identity, private canary, exact lineage, semantic readback, rollback and cost gates pass.
mission.continuity: Atomic hash-chain state, circuit quarantine, two-proof restoration, project memory, Formation specification and AI handoff preserve bounded continuity.

assumptions.stack: Python is the primary runtime and Google ADK/GenAI are installed from exact direct pins.
assumptions.runtime: Linux/Cloud Run compatible runtime with a non-root identity and writable JARVIS_STATE_DIR.
assumptions.storage: Local JSONL is sufficient for source verification; managed transactional state is required before horizontal production scaling.
assumptions.authentication: Local HTTP uses a bearer secret; Google capabilities use separate least-scope OAuth or dedicated service identity.
assumptions.deployment: No live deployment claim is allowed until the provider-native zero-traffic gate succeeds.

components.frontend: Packaged responsive HTML interface with loading, error, token and capability-truth controls
components.backend: Typed Python domain objects, canonical five-node deterministic graph, HTTP/CLI and ADK Workflow entrypoints
components.database: Concurrency-safe hash-chained JSONL; managed production database ADAPTER_REQUIRED before multi-instance writes
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: no asynchronous effectful jobs are enabled in this release
components.worker: Single synchronous governed graph; provider tool worker is feature-disabled
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: on-demand release has no background autonomy
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: semantic/model responses are not cached
components.storage: Local atomic state and packaged versioned doctrine resource
components.authentication: Constant-time bearer comparison; typed request schemas and exact user grant/OAuth/IAM/mission/tool/resource intersection for future provider adapters

observability.correlation_ids: Mission IDs, route IDs, content hashes and learning hashes
observability.health_checks: GET /health separates ledger integrity, provider mode, session proof and maturity
observability.structured_logs: Secret-free JSON response and ledger schemas; raw prompts and provider payloads are not logged
observability.audit_logs: Fsync-backed hash-chain that blocks writes after corruption, with optional HMAC checkpoint against full-chain recomputation
observability.metrics_alerts: Local elapsed time, semantic fruit and quarantine state; provider alerting ADAPTER_REQUIRED before deployment

testing.unit: Provider settings, typed action/resource/argument schemas, permit cryptography/bindings/key strength, math AST, doctrine and authority intersection
testing.integration: Canonical graph to semantic verifier to atomic learning ledger
testing.e2e_or_smoke: CLI offline response, interactive math calculation, cloud-deploy denial, browser bootstrap ordering and packaged resource load
testing.fixtures_mocks: Deterministic successful, failing and short-response provider doubles plus temporary state directories
testing.failure_first: False-live env, provider configuration denial, action/resource/argument bypass, weak permit key, permit mismatch/expiry/replay, generic effect claim, unexpected provider exception, input poisoning, proofless breaker recovery, code injection, ledger tamper and write-after-corruption

deploy_commands: BLOCKED_WITH_ROUTE: repair Google machine authority, generate transitive lock, build zero-traffic private candidate, run two-pass semantic/lineage canary, then promote exact revision
rollback_commands: BLOCKED_UNTIL_DEPLOYMENT: restore the captured prior Cloud Run traffic allocation and independently verify health plus semantics
delivery.debugging: Read health.providerMode and maturity; inspect only secret-free error code; verify exact env configuration; check quarantine; validate ledger; run provider_canary; never infer provider fruit from HTTP 200.

formation.effectful_permit: formation:mission-v22:consumed-prior-publication; new provider mutation requires a fresh permit

watchman.preserved_core: Offline graph, math, doctrine, security gates and local interfaces remain functional when every external provider is absent.
watchman.closure_test: Each adapter must independently prove current identity, exact scopes/allowlist, semantic fruit and rollback without weakening another route.

continuity.idempotency: Read routes are deterministic where possible; no effectful adapter is enabled; future writes require idempotency keys and preimages.
continuity.checkpoints: Graph node events, learning hashes, capability truth, contract proof and release commit/readback.
continuity.resume_conditions: Resume an isolated provider lane only after current authority, two bounded recovery proofs, cost fit and unchanged protected controls.
continuity.stop_switch: Unset provider mode, revoke runtime secret/identity, or quarantine the exact route; no background executor exists.

semantic_verification.fruit: five distinct node events, doctrine-aware non-generic response, generic effect-completion claims rejected, response/evidence hashes, semanticFruit=true, learningPromotion=NOT_PROMOTED

external_proof_gaps: ADK and GenAI packages are not installed in this scratch runtime; official API structure is source-checked but installed-package integration remains a deployment gate
transitive dependency hashes are not generated
production permit signing and nonce/effect state require an externally isolated globally transactional authority; local HMAC/file state is test-only
ledger and breaker require managed durable state before multi-instance execution
Gemini and Workspace have no live runtime identity/readback
private Cloud Run, lineage, rollback and cost proof have not run
